verdict.rationale: Publishing operating hours, daily limits, or session timeouts up front is a fair question for any government online-filing portal, so the axis applies. The evidence pack holds only page titles for filing procedures and a probe of the open-data API, and none of it mentions service hours, per-day caps, or session-timeout disclosures.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
